events.verdict: Black (ORL) grabs and pulls Turner (IND) around the waist, causing him to lose his balance in the lane.
Haliburton (IND) sets the screen on Carter. Jr. (ORL) with his arms slightly extended and the marginal contact is accentuated by Suggs (ORL) pushing Carter Jr.
Turner (IND) loses control of his dribble and legally regains possession.
Carter Jr. (ORL) places a hand on Haliburton's (IND) side with no extension as Haliburton's momentum carries him towards the baseline.
Caldwell-Pope (ORL) briefly grasps and releases Turner's (IND) shorts as he moves around the screen.
Turner (IND) places his hands on Caldwell-Pope's (ORL) back without extending into him as he releases.
Haliburton (IND) gathers the ball on his right foot and takes three steps before coming to a stop.
Suggs (ORL) maintains his pivot foot during the pump fake and before he releases his dribble.
Carter Jr. (ORL) quickly extends a hand towards Nembhard (IND) before correcting and maintaining a legal guarding position during the drive to the basket.
Suggs (ORL) appears to graze Turner's (IND) elbow during the jump shot attempt but there is no clear and conclusive video evidence that the contact is illegal.
Turner (IND) is in the lane for longer than three seconds.

Sheppard (IND) and Suggs (ORL) each make clean contact with the ball and the ensuing contact is incidental. Suggs then comes together in mid-air with his teammate Black (ORL), which causes Suggs to fall to the floor.
Siakam (IND) commits a take foul on Banchero (ORL).
Banchero (ORL) legally contests Siakam's (IND) jump shot attempt.
